# 2 Baruch Chapter 40 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** The rule of my Anointed One that has been revealed will stand forever — until the corrupt world comes to its end and until the times spoken of above are completed.

**2** That is the vision you saw, and that is its interpretation.

**3** Then I said, "O Lord my Lord — will I myself survive until those days? And who will be alive in that time?"

**4** He answered me: "What will become of others — that you will not know. But what concerns you personally — that you will know, for the Most High has revealed these things to you."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering. The vision ends with a personal question. Baruch wants to know his own fate. God's answer distinguishes between public knowledge (the fate of others — hidden) and personal revelation (Baruch's own fate — will be shown).*
